capabilities: Take timestamped notes that sync with embedded YouTube video playback
Manage multiple videos per note with a sortable, draggable list
Fetch YouTube captions and create notes from transcript lines
Generate timestamped notes from transcripts via AI providers
Export videos and notes to Markdown with clickable timestamp links
extras: Known iOS/iPadOS issue: the YouTube player fails with Error 153 due to a WKWebView Referer-header bug, not plugin code. Development is supported via Ko-fi and GitHub Sponsors; BRAT is supported for pre-release testing.
problem: Obsidian's YouTube embeds don't link playback position to note timestamps, and there is no workflow for keeping several videos and timestamped notes together in a single file.

requires.name: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or OpenAI-compatible provider

summary: Timestamped note-taking view for multiple embedded YouTube videos in one note, with transcript fetching and optional AI-generated notes.
